claims.text: The rider's own trip record and the platform's GPS trace agree that this trip was driven 14.31 km against a booked optimal route of 2.4 km. The excess is 11.91 km, which is 496.25% of the optimal distance. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass by an enormous margin: the excess exceeds 20% of optimal and exceeds 0.8 km absolute. The deviation is established, and it is additionally MATERIAL because the excess exceeds both 50% of optimal and 8.0 km absolute.

The GPS trace is clean for policy purposes: 130 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds. POL-RD-07(a) to (c) are not met, so the trace is not impaired and the deviation may be established on the trace alone without independent corroboration.

The rider has discharged the POL-RD-08 initial burden: the trip identifier TRP-02848 matches across the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown, and the excess measured from an unimpaired trace meets the POL-RD-01 threshold. The burden now shifts to the driver to point to a specific artifact and clause.

The driver's only explanation is a bare assertion in his counterparty statement that 'the rider changed the destination verbally.' That assertion cites no evidence ID and no clause. Under POL-RD-08 a general assertion unsupported by an artifact discharges nothing, and under POL-RD-04 a rider-requested detour requires a chat_log instruction from the rider, timestamped before the vehicle left the optimal corridor, identifying a place or road specifically enough to act on, corroborated by the trace passing within 200 m of a waypoint_hint. The chat log for this trip contains zero messages, so POL-RD-04(a) to (c) cannot be met and the clause is unavailable.

The driver's verbal-destination-change excuse also fails under POL-RD-05: the trip record shows original_pickup, original_dropoff, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at all null, and amended_optimal_distance_km null. No amendment is recorded, so there is no amended endpoint against which to re-run POL-RD-01 and no basis to reduce the excess.

No traffic advisory covers this trip. The advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02848-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and no payload, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run: there is no advisory naming a road the optimal route traverses, no validity window, and no shortest_lawful_alternative_km. Under POL-RD-13 the driver's traffic excuse, if any, carries no weight, and the deviation stands at the measured figure.

The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs the remedy. The recomputed fare on the booked optimal route is ((3.80 + 0.75 x 2.4 + 0.28 x 5.0) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP = 7.80. The charged total is 21.35. The refund is 21.35 - 7.80 = 13.55, which is 63.47% of the charged total, above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 13.55.

The fare breakdown carries zero ERP lines and zero tolls, so there is no off-route pass-through to add on top of the POL-RD-02 figure and no billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4). The refund is the distance-and-time recomputation alone.

The driver's profile does not establish a repeat deviation pattern under POL-RD-06: deviation_flags_90d is 0 and completed_trips_90d is 210, so neither the 3-or-more limb nor the 0.05 ratio limb is met. The MATERIAL deviation therefore does not attract the POL-RD-06(b) FULL_REFUND uplift, and the remedy remains the POL-RD-02 partial. I concede this point: the driver's clean 90-day deviation record is a fact in his favour and I do not stretch it.

The rider's profile does not trigger the POL-RD-08 corroboration requirement: deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the threshold of 4, so no additional corroboration beyond the GPS trace is required for this claim.

Nothing reduces the excess. No traffic advisory covers this trip either: EV-ADVIS-02848-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and any external-traffic explanation is weightless under POL-RD-08 (POL-RD-13; the missing advisory no party properly cited is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction). To both parties: this was a metered RydeX trip on 18 Aug 2026 from Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 to Blk 25 Ghim Moh Link, booked as a 2.4 km / 5.0 minute run. The rider is refunded SGD 13.55.

Under POL-RD-01 the governing distance figure is the GPS trace, not the trip record's rounded copy: gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 14.31 km against a booked optimal of 2.4 km on the trip record (the trip record's 14.3 km is the same measurement rounded and may not be cited for the threshold test). The excess is 11.91 km, or 496.25% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 tests pass by a wide margin (more than 0.8 km absolute and more than 20% of optimal), and the excess also crosses both materiality marks (more than 8.0 km and more than 50%).

THE TRACE IS NOT IMPAIRED. POL-RD-07 is not engaged: 130 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so limbs (a) to (c) do not fire and the excess may be measured from the trace itself without independent corroboration. The rider's POL-RD-08 initial burden is discharged: trip identifier TRP-02848 matches across the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown, and the trace is unimpaired.

THE ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02). The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not close off the distance-and-time remedy and POL-RD-02 governs:
  charged_total: SGD 21.35
  recomputed_fare: ((3.80 + 0.75 x 2.4 + 0.28 x 5.0) x 1.00 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP = SGD 7.80
  refund: 21.35 - 7.80 = SGD 13.55
That is 63.5% of the charged total - above the SGD 0.50 de minimis, below the 90% full-refund share - so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 13.55 (already on a 5-cent step, so rounding up changes nothing).

THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATIONS. The driver's statement that the rider changed the destination verbally is noted, but it cites no evidence ID and no clause; under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence carries no weight and is discarded. POL-RD-04 requires a rider instruction recorded in the chat log - from the rider, timestamped before the vehicle left the optimal corridor or within 3 minutes of it, identifying an actionable place or road, and corroborated by the trace passing within 200 m of that message's waypoint_hint. The chat log for this trip contains zero messages, so there is no instruction, no waypoint_hint and no road to test; POL-RD-04 is unavailable on this record and no distance is excluded under it. POL-RD-05 is likewise unavailable: original_pickup, original_dropoff, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are all null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so there are no amended endpoints and the booked 2.4 km baseline stands. On the traffic side, no advisory covers this trip - the only advisory artifact in the bundle is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT - so no road-closure exoneration under POL-RD-03 was available to either party, and the missing advisory is not an escalation trigger under POL-RD-10(5) because the excuse was not asserted against any cited artifact.

DRIVER CONDUCT. Because the deviation is MATERIAL, the POL-RD-06 profile check was run. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 210 completed trips in 90 days, so neither the 3-flag limb nor the 0.05 ratio limb is met. The FULL_REFUND uplift in POL-RD-06(b) does not apply, and there is no referral to driver-conduct review under POL-RD-06(c).

PASS-THROUGH LINES. The fare breakdown shows no ERP gantries, tolls of 0.00 and an airport surcharge of 0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport, so there is nothing to add on top of the POL-RD-02 figure under POL-RD-09 and no billing-integrity defect.

PROFILES. The rider's profile is used only for its citable field: deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the threshold of 4, so no corroboration beyond the trace is required (POL-RD-08). No other profile field was used, and none may be.

NO ESCALATION. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the trip identifiers and timestamps agree across artifacts, the trace is unimpaired, no exculpatory clause was invoked against a missing or field-deficient cited artifact, the refund is well under SGD 150.00 and under charged_total, the sides are not in comparable-strength contradiction (the driver offered no evidence at all), and every charge line has a counterpart in the trace or trip record. There is no driver compensation: the billed distance (14.3 km) is not less than the trace distance (14.31 km), so POL-RD-04's unbilled-kilometre limb does not arise.

NEXT STEPS. This ruling was made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04. Because the monetary effect of SGD 13.55 exceeds the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, the ruling issues but the amount is held and placed in the human queue for release under POL-GEN-05.
